To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the bio based high performance poly (aryl etherketone) derived from furan and phenol have been successfully prepared.
a novel bio based poly (ether ketone) with excellent processability was prepared via nucleophilic aromatic polycondensation.
a new bio based poly (arylether ketone) with good mechanical properties and processibility was prepared by using the bio based monomers, 2,5-furan dicarboxylic acids.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of bio based poly (ether ketone)s derived from 2.5 furandicarbolic acid and the influence on the properties of the resins.
the synthesis of a new bio based poly (ether ketone) with enhanced processability and thermal properties.
a novel bio based poly (arylether ketone) with excellent properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a new kind of bio based poly (ether ketone) resins with enhanced processability have been successfully synthesized and the results of the characterization of the resins have been discussed.
the bio based poly (arylene ether ketone) with enhanced processability has been successfully developed.
the novel bio based poly (ether ketone)s derived from furan have been successfully prepared and their thermal, mechanical, rheological and solubility properties were investigated.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the bio based poly (arylether ketone) with enhanced processability has been successfully synthesized via nucleophilic aromatic polymerization.

the new bio based poly (ether ether ketone) resins with excellent thermal stability, processability and mechanical properties have been synthesized by the nucleophilic substitution polycondensation of 2,5-furandicarboxyl chloride with 1,4-dihydroxybenzene and 4,4-dihydropyphenyl.
the novel bio based poly (ether ketone)s were prepared via the facile nucleophilic aromatic substitutions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the bio based resists with good mechanical properties and processable can be obtained by the introduction of furan ring into polymer chains.

the bio based poly (arylene ether ketone) with enhanced processability can be successfully synthesized via the polymerization of 2,5-furandicarboxylate with bisphenol-A and 4,4'-dihydroxydiphenyl ether.

the furan can be used as a renewable resource to substitute phenyl in the synthesis of high performance poly (aryl etherketone) with enhanced processability, which can be used as the substitute for petroleum based resins in the future.
